## Request
Fundamental credit synthesis for Northbridge Holdings plc as of 2026-03-31.

## Findings

### Bottom line
Northbridge is a fair credit: steady aftermarket cash flow is offset by sponsor-led financial policy.

### Limitations
Market share was not scored because no reliable market data was supplied.

### T2.12 Monitoring triggers

| Trigger | Threshold / Signal | Why It Matters | Credit Impact | Source / Limitation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Net leverage above 5.0x | Two consecutive quarters | Signals a debt-funded step up in borrowing. | Negative | NBG_annual_2025.pdf, page 60 |
| Refinancing not launched by 2026-09-30 | Launch date passes | Leaves the 2027 term loan unrefinanced. | Negative | NBG_press_release_2026-03.pdf, page 1 |

### T2.13 - Credit scorecard

| Factor | Level | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| Scale | 2 | **Adjusted EBITDA** of GBP 351.2m sits in the 200–500m band *(FY2025)*. |
| Market position | 2 | Top-tier competitor in industrial flow control. |
| Regulatory exposure | 2 | Moderate oversight with a manageable compliance burden. |
| Technology | 2 | Competitive adopter; technology is embedded in strategy. |
| Barriers to entry | 3 | Moderate barriers from know-how and cost efficiency. |
| Leverage | 3 | Net leverage of about 4.1x is elevated but stable. |
| Free cash flow | 3 | Modest free cash flow, positive in stable years only. |
| Liquidity | 2 | Cash and the undrawn revolver cover 12–24 months. |
| Rating trend | 3 | Balanced risk of upgrade or downgrade. |
| Geographic diversification | 2 | Two major regions, one contributing 40–50% of revenue. |
| Product diversification | 3 | One main product line contributes 60–70% of sales. |
| Market share | Not scored | Not supplied: no reliable market share data. |
| Customer concentration | 2 | Top three customers are under 20% of sales. |
| Market access | 2 | Regular market access with a well-followed credit. |
| Maturity profile | 3 | Moderate maturities, likely refinanced in 2026. |
| Interest cover | 3 | EBITDA to cash interest of 5.1x is solid for the band. |
| Financial policy | 3 | Neutral policy with some shareholder bias. |
